headline: Senate advances Survivor Justice Tax Prevention Act post-cloture as anti-fraud bills move to victory lap!

senate.lastSessionSummary: The Senate continued floor debate on H.R. 2347, the Survivor Justice Tax Prevention Act, adopting a substitute amendment 69-27 and securing cloture 65-31 to advance the measure. Meanwhile, two anti-fraud bills cleared the chamber: the Financial Exploitation Prevention Act, which extends investment protections for seniors, and the Veterans Protection from Fraud Act, which enhances criminal penalties for crimes targeting veterans.

onTheFloor.title: Survivor Justice Tax Prevention Act - exclude damages from sexual misconduct from gross income for tax purposes
onTheFloor.status: cloture invoked 65-31, post-cloture debate continues Thursday at 10 a.m.

onTheFloor.title: Financial Exploitation Prevention Act - protect seniors from financial exploitation in securities redemptions
Veterans Protection from Fraud Act - enhance criminal penalties for crimes against veterans

house.lastSessionSummary: The House passed the Earth MRI Reauthorization Act 396-14 under suspension of rules, reauthorizing the Earth Mapping Resources Initiative. The chamber also approved the Dismantle Foreign Scam Syndicates Act and the Settlement Agreement Information Database Act, while debate on the Preventive Health Savings Act was postponed for further consideration.

onTheFloor.title: Earth MRI Reauthorization Act - reauthorize the Earth Mapping Resources Initiative under Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act
Dismantle Foreign Scam Syndicates Act - establish task force to dismantle transnational criminal scam operations
Settlement Agreement Information Database Act - require publication of settlement agreements
Preventive Health Savings Act - amend Congressional Budget Act scoring of preventive health savings
